semantic.justification: Original represented text-snippet UTF16 slicing, hard line break, hard/soft hyphen substitutions, and CH_TXTATR_BREAKWORD removal. The current Writer item pool has no RES_CHRATR_CASEMAP, so only source non-title-case behavior is admitted. RTF run emission consumes this owner before RunText/RawText. Full MSWord attribute/script/bidi iteration, capitalization with ICU/break iterators and other wrtw8nds.cxx responsibilities remain unported and are not certified.
